patterns.symptom: Phase 4a exits with reviewed status, skipping review phase
patterns.description: Writer validation_failed sets status=reviewed instead of written, causing Phase 4b to be skipped
patterns.rootCause: updateChapterStatus() in orchestrator.ts sets status='reviewed' on validation_failed

detection.stateCheck: chapters with status='reviewed' but no review files
detection.command: cat project-state.json | jq '.chapters | to_entries | map(select(.value.status == "reviewed")) | length'

patterns.fix: Set status='written' on validation_failed, update Phase 4a exit condition to exclude 'reviewed'

patterns.symptom: Phase 4d deadlocks when all chapters exceed maxRounds
patterns.description: Phase 4d validate returns blocked but exit condition never satisfied
patterns.rootCause: allExceeded detection returns blocked instead of marking chapters as terminal

detection.stateCheck: all chapters reviewed+revise with round >= maxRounds
detection.command: cat project-state.json | jq '.chapters | to_entries | map(select(.value.status == "reviewed" and .value.round >= 5)) | length'

patterns.fix: Mark chapters as completed/failed when allExceeded detected

patterns.symptom: Fixer tasks not spawned for all chapters needing fixes
patterns.description: Phase 4d only spawns fixers for subset of chapters
patterns.rootCause: generateFixTasks() logic error or maxConcurrency limit

detection.stateCheck: chapters with status='reviewed' and verdict='revise' but no fixer task
detection.command: cat project-state.json | jq '.chapters | to_entries | map(select(.value.status == "reviewed" and .value.lastReviewVerdict == "revise")) | map(.key)'

patterns.fix: Ensure generateFixTasks() iterates all chapters with reviewed+revise status

patterns.description: Round counter jumps by 2 instead of 1 when reviewer rejects
patterns.rootCause: Both orchestrator.ts and phases.ts increment round on reject
patterns.fix: Remove round increment from phases.ts, keep only in orchestrator.ts

patterns.symptom: DIAG logs flooding TUI, hiding subagent status
patterns.description: console.log DIAG messages output to TUI instead of only to log files
patterns.rootCause: LoggingSystem.handleEvent() outputs all events including diag.* to TUI

detection.stateCheck: TUI shows DIAG messages instead of subagent status

patterns.fix: Filter diag.* events in handleEvent(), only write to log files not TUI

patterns.description: Critical events defined in types but never emitted by code
patterns.rootCause: EventBus.emit() calls missing in key locations
patterns.fix: Add emit() calls for all defined event types

patterns.description: All chapters fail validation due to word count > max
patterns.rootCause: LLM cannot accurately control word count, budget too strict

detection.command: cat project-state.json | jq '.chapters | to_entries | map(select(.value.consecutiveFailures > 0)) | length'

patterns.fix: Adjust word budget tolerance or improve prompt guidance

state-machine.description: State machine logic errors, phase transitions, deadlocks

logging.description: Log output, event emission, TUI display

detectionCommands.invalidTransition: cat logs/confwrite-log.jsonl | jq -r 'select(.event.type == "chapter.status") | "\(.event.chapterId) | \(.event.from) → \(.event.to)"' | grep -E 'pending → completed|written → pending'
detectionCommands.missingTasks: cat project-state.json | jq -r '.chapters | to_entries | map(select(.value.status == "reviewed" and .value.lastReviewVerdict == "revise")) | map(.key)'
detectionCommands.taskTimeout: for log in logs/subagent-*.log; do last_turn=$(grep 'Turn #' $log | tail -1 | grep -oP 'Turn #\K[0-9]+'); if [ $last_turn -gt 50 ]; then echo "TIMEOUT: $log"; fi; done
